| MARGIN_BUY_PRESSURE_5 | external | B | pit_capital | cross_sectional_signal | ratio | missing_nan | medium | -1 | low | margin_detail_pit.rzmre, daily_basic_pit.circ_mv | medium_cross_section | joint visibility of two sources: the financing detail of session t-1 becomes visible at session t (v2 margin_detail_pit available_date, p17 §6.1 T+1) AND the float-cap denominator from the same-session daily_basic_pit close (trade_date-keyed; the session-t basic values are known at the session-t close, the D4-era daily-basic convention); a value is available at session t only when both sources are visible | Margin buy pressure: heavy 5-session margin buying per unit of float cap marks leveraged chasing that subsequently retraces (the -1 main hypothesis; the +1 chase-continuation alternative adjudicated by the measurement). |

| SUB | 2 | arithmetic | price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal ; price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal | （Phase E 定） | low | exact float subtraction; float32 rounding only |
| MUL | 2 | arithmetic | price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal ; price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal | （Phase E 定） | low | exact float multiplication; magnitudes can overflow to inf in extreme tails |
| DIV | 2 | arithmetic | price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal ; price_like/return_like/volume_like/fundamental_like/cross_sectional_signal/boolean_event_signal | （Phase E 定） | low | zero-denominator guard: denom == 0 maps to eps with sign, so the result stays finite |
